## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid twenty-year-old youth. He has a round, expressionless face and demonstrates a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

A big, fat twenty-year-old youth with a round, expressionless face, Billy Andrews is a stolid individual who suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He harbors a mortal fear of social invitations and fine gatherings, often fleeing to avoid them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## History

Billy Andrews drove [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert. After the event, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a praised performance, he drove the girls back home under the moonlight while they discussed their thoughts on the evening.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. He acts as a driver for [Jane](../character/jane.md) and her friends, taking [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to and from a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).
